title: 第1141章 公子带你们去一个地方第1140章 独角鲨炼制的鱼油
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
李蒙两眼放光看着旱魃腰背下的浑圆。
一团黑雾突然涌现包裹了李蒙。
道童李蒙变成了少年李蒙。
少年李蒙扑向了旱魃。
不多时，帘帐晃动了起来。
内室中顿时响起了一些动静。
直到一个时辰后宫楼才安静了下来。
只听“咯吱”一声。
宫楼大门被从里面打开了。
李蒙一脸神清气爽的走了出来。
脚步略显轻浮。
身上的气息也略显紊乱。
走出宫楼大门来到庭院的李蒙转身抬头看了一眼上层某个房间。
眼中闪过了一丝好奇。
也不知旱魃是何修为。
肉身就好像一座巍峨大山。
不论他怎么努力都无法撼动分毫。
在旱魃面前他只是受挫的份。
旱魃只是单纯的陪他玩乐而已。
从始至终李蒙都明白这一点。

李蒙转身走向了楼亭。
时间已经不早了。
清漪与雪儿应该要来了。
李蒙走进了楼亭。
在石桌旁坐了下来。
刚坐下，别苑大门就被人从外面打开了。
身穿紫色宫装长裙的清漪走了进来。
当看到楼亭中的公子时。
沈清漪脸上露出了笑容。
丰腴的腰臀随着轻盈的步伐而摇摆着。
紧绷的衣裙勾画出了诱人的浑圆曲线。
“公子今日心情似乎不错？”
沈清漪面带微笑走进了楼亭。
李蒙朝着清漪笑了笑。
“见清漪你来了，公子自然高兴。”
沈清漪抿嘴一笑。
朝着公子拱手行礼。
content_en:
Li Meng's eyes shone brightly as he looked at the round figure under Han Bao's waist.
A black mist suddenly emerged and enveloped Li Meng.
Taoist boy Li Meng became young Li Meng.
Young Li Meng pounced on Hanba.
After a while, the curtain began to shake.
There was some movement in the inner room.
It wasn't until an hour later that the harem building became quiet.
Just listen to a "creak".
The palace door was opened from the inside.
Li Meng walked out with a refreshed look on his face.
The steps are slightly frivolous.
The breath on his body was also slightly disordered.
Li Meng, who walked out of the palace gate and came to the courtyard, turned around and looked up at a room on the upper floor.
A trace of curiosity flashed in his eyes.
I don’t know what kind of cultivation Hanbao is.
The physical body is like a towering mountain.
No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't shake it.
In front of Han Bao, he was just frustrated.
Hanba was just playing with him.
Li Meng understood this from beginning to end.
Li Meng turned around and walked towards Louting.
It's getting late.
Qingyi and Xueer should be coming.
Li Meng walked into the pavilion.
He sat down at the stone table.
As soon as he sat down, the door of the Bieyuan was opened from the outside.
Qingyi, wearing a purple palace dress, walked in.
When I saw the young master in the pavilion.
A smile appeared on Shen Qingyi's face.
The plump waist and hips swayed with the light steps.
The tight dress outlines attractive round curves.
"Young Master seems to be in a good mood today?"
Shen Qingyi walked into the pavilion with a smile.
Li Meng smiled at Qingyi.
"The young master will naturally be happy to see you here, Qingyi."
Shen Qingyi pursed her lips and smiled.
He bowed his hands towards the young master and saluted.
